pairs_touching.notes_for_p3b: Two independently-constructed parallel analogies (different source traditions: seven chakras vs. Patanjali's five mental states) both mapped onto knowledge-maturity pipelines; similar purpose but not shown to be the same object, not shown to be genuinely distinct either -- textbook weak-signal UNWITNESSED case per protocol calibration guidance.
pairs_touching.what_says_this: Checked all rows for both (12 for a, 1 for b, neither truncated): no lineage_claims or dual-labeled rows connect a and b anywhere. a's own S0493 lineage_claims (SOURCE-CLAIMED-REFINEMENT/CORRECTION) target only 'the previous chakra=knowledge-layer vertical-stack model' (i.e. a's own earlier S0229 mapping, self-refined), not b. The group's own why_grouped note explicitly flags this as merely 'possibly overlapping (both are staged progressions toward mature/sovereign knowledge) though the two use different stage counts and different framing (organizational maturity vs. intent-to-reality transformation)' -- an acknowledgment of surface similarity (both are analogical mappings of an Eastern contemplative-tradition staged model onto a KnowledgeOS knowledge-maturity pipeline) without any claimed or demonstrated dependency between the two specific analogies (7-chakra manifestation pipeline vs. 5-levels-of-mind processing pipeline).
pairs_touching.what_would_make_this_wrong: If a later document in the corpus explicitly merges or cross-references the two stage progressions (e.g. mapping specific chakra layers onto specific mind-levels), that would establish either genuine continuity (upgrading toward EXTENSION/SAME) or an explicit SOURCE-CLAIMED-SEPARATION (supporting HOMONYM) -- either would supersede this default UNWITNESSED verdict.

pairs_touching.notes_for_p3b: b's own row explicitly frames this as analogy-extraction, not literal correction of engineering fact (S0494: 'frames the entire exercise as extracting an architectural pattern... as analogy'), so the refinement is at the level of the KnowledgeOS-mapping exercise, not a claim that the earlier chakra mapping was factually wrong.
pairs_touching.what_says_this: S0493, present in a's own sample as a CORRECTION-typed row, states directly: 'The author states the earlier chakra -> knowledge-layer vertical-stack mapping was too simplistic and must be refined into a multi-lens model rather than a single renamed stack' and 'Demotes chakras from architecture to a diagnostic vocabulary for systemic knowledge health.' The b family (S0493/S0494) is exactly that refinement: a twelve-lens reference model (ontology/epistemology/cognitive-architecture/DDD/cybernetics/governance/etc) in which the original seven-chakra pipeline becomes one lens (the 'Structure' lens: tattvas/koshas/faculties/chakras) among many, rather than the sole architecture.
pairs_touching.what_would_make_this_wrong: If S0493's multi-lens model turns out to be an independently-authored alternative proposal never adopted as a correction of S0229's chakra-pipeline (e.g. if both stand as competing, un-reconciled candidates in the corpus), REFINEMENT would overstate the relation and UNWITNESSED would be safer.
